# f5xc_bgp_routing_policy (Resource)

BGP Routing Policy is a list of rules, which contains match criteria and<br>action to be taken upon match. This helps in filtering routes which are<br>exported or imported by BGP peers

To get more information about f5xc_bgp_routing_policy, refer:

- [API documentation](https://docs.cloud.f5.com/docs-v2/api/bgp-routing-policy)

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example: Bgp Routing Policy - Full

resource "f5xc_bgp_routing_policy" "example" {
  name        = "example-bgp-routing-policy"
  namespace   = "system"
  description = "BGP routing policy example"

  labels = {
    env  = "acceptance"
    team = "example-team"
  }

  annotations = {
    owner = "network"
  }

  rules = [{
    match = {
      type_of_match_choice = {
        ip_prefixes = {
          prefixes = [{
            ip_prefixes = "10.20.0.0/16"
            prefix_length_match_choice = {
              exact_match = true
            }
          }]
        }
      }
    }
    action = {
      action_type_choice = {
        local_preference = 150
      }
    }
  }]
}
```

### Nested Schema for `rules.match.type_of_match_choice.ip_prefixes.prefixes.prefix_length_match_choice`

Optional:

- `equal_or_longer_than` (Boolean) ge_match Choose a prefix equal orlonger than a particular prefix. For example if you choose 10.1.1.0/20 this encompasses a range from 10.1.0.0 to to 10.1.15.255. Any prefix in the routing table that falls within this range will be matched e.g. 10.1.2.0/24, 10.1.3.0/24. This would also match the 10.1.1.0/20.
- `exact_match` (Boolean) exact_match Match the exact prefix length specified in IP prefix
- `longer_than` (Boolean) longer_than Choose a prefix longer than a particular prefix. For example if you choose 10.1.1.0/20 this encompasses a range from 10.1.0.0 to to 10.1.15.255. Any prefix in the routing table that falls within this range will be matched e.g. 10.1.2.0/24, 10.1.3.0/24. This wouldn’t match the 10.1.1.0/20.
